question: 在投稿 MATLAB 参数实验的精确设计点上，本仓 ModifiedUnscentedFilter + InteractingMultipleModel(full) 能否复现 trackingUKF/trackingIMM 的状态轨迹与模型概率轨迹

filter_settings.assimilation_steps: k = 2..3649 (1-based): predict with p[k-1], etpot[k-1]; correct with qobs[k]

g0_input_consistency.q_s_all_rule: all twelve equal q_s_truth cell 1 = 1e-6*diag([140,1000,4,1200,0]) (actual workspace value; script text drifted)
g0_input_consistency.noise_std_consistency: per-column empirical std of noise_q_truth within 5% of sqrt(diag(1e-6*diag([140,1000,4,1200,0]))) for nonzero columns; column 5 exactly zero

g1_walrus_open_loop.comparison: python replay with phase-switched truth params + noise_q_truth, obs noise added to last column, vs states_obs
g1_walrus_open_loop.on_fail: fix port until pass or document semantic mismatch as finding; do not proceed to G2 while failing

g2_single_filter.comparison: 12 independent ModifiedUnscentedFilter runs vs states_upd_filters cells
g2_single_filter.metric: first_exceed(y) = first step where max abs state diff > 1e-6 * max(1, abs(reference))
g2_single_filter.strong_pass: no exceedance in any of 12 filters over 3649 steps
g2_single_filter.on_exceed: report first_exceed distribution + step-level diagnostics (sigma points, prior, gain); tolerance may not be relaxed post hoc

anchor_metrics.stable_definition: prob argmax stays rank-1 from that cycle until phase end

verdict_tiers: 数值一致: G1 pass AND G2 strong AND G3 strong
结构等价: G1 pass AND all four G3 anchors reproduced within tolerances
部分等价: G1 pass AND anchors partially reproduced (itemize, no aggregate claim)
不等价: G1 unfixable or majority anchors fail (report first divergence step and located cause)

review.layer_2: independent context recomputes comparison metrics from the .mat and sealed outputs

scope_exclusions: any modification of frozen ID23 evidence or seeds
